approval.approval_basis: Approved by the researcher in project chat on 2026-11-14 (message 'approve'); the DailyMed label was checked as current (lisinopril v12, 9 Oct 2026) by Claude, who also confirmed the label XML served on 2026-11-14 is byte-identical to the capture (SHA-256 351409a1...a7e6) and that section 5.5 re-extracted from it equals the evidence text; record prepared by Claude.

supported_claim: Potassium-containing salt substitutes are listed as a risk factor for hyperkalemia in patients receiving lisinopril, and the label advises periodic serum potassium monitoring.
patient_context_relevance: The passage also lists renal insufficiency and diabetes mellitus as hyperkalemia risk factors; it sets no potassium limit and no diet.
not_supported: any daily potassium limit or diet plan
verification_required_before_approval: Open https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=34ebeea1-6812-4697-84c4-b2ae4f39e55f and confirm section 5.5 Hyperkalemia reads as the evidence text.
Confirm generated food guidance stays within supported_claim (a risk factor with monitoring, not an instruction to avoid).
